title: Errors you can read
description:
Give a C API error codes and messages that are easy to use.

```
open("") -> XN_ERR_ARGUMENT: path must not be empty
open("missing.cfg") -> XN_ERR_NOT_FOUND: no such file: missing.cfg
xn_error_name(99) -> "XN_ERR_UNKNOWN"
```
hints: `thread_local std::string g_message;` and return `g_message.c_str()`: the pointer stays valid until the next call on that thread (lesson 3.02).
A `switch` with a `default: return "XN_ERR_UNKNOWN";` handles codes from newer versions.
requirements: An `enum` of codes with 0 as success, and `const char* xn_error_name(int code)`.
A thread-local detail message set by each failing call: `const char* xn_last_message(void)`.
Codes never change meaning once released: add new ones at the end.
stretch: Add a callback the host can register to receive every error message.
